--- about key text ---
Bhagwant University, Ajmer is a UGC-recognized State University committed to academic excellence, innovation, ethical values, and preparing future-ready professionals for global success.
Innovative Practices in Curriculum & Syllabi at  Bhagwant University Ajmer
Bhagwant University is established by Bhagwant Education Foundation which has also established Bhagwant Global University Kotdwar conducting professional programs such as B.Sc. Agriculture , MBA, BBA etc.  Bhagwant University is formed under the aegis of Bhagwant Group of Institutions and  has been established by Government of Rajasthan and approved by UGC, as per section 2f of UGC Act 1956. It is a JEE listed university & is a member of AIU, FICCI, AIMA, IAP. It is also an ISO-9001 certified University.
Bhagwant University offers under graduate, post graduate & PhD programs in technical & professional courses like Engineering, Management, Pharmacy, Education, Media & Mass Communication, Medical Science, Applied Sciences, and Humanities. This is the only University in Rajasthan which has the most demanding & upcoming engineering courses like Aeronautics, Petroleum, Nanotechnology and Agriculture.
The University has state-of-the-art physical and academic infrastructure, with educated, learned and highly qualified faculty members. It has collaboration with international universities to give global exposure to students. The best academic results serve as testimony to the fact that the students are technically competent to work in various disciplines of the corporate world as well as govt. sectors.
Bhagwant University is located on Sikar road, Ajmer. It is about 10 kms. from bus station and 12kms. from railway station.The University is well connected with bus services at intra-city level and with rail and road at  intercity level.The University building is not just aesthetically built but is very functional and well set in green environment.
Established by Govt. of Rajasthan under Act No. 18 of 2008
Best Group of Institutions by AIMA 2014 · Best University in Rajasthan
Part of the Bhagwant Group of Institutions — one of the fastest-growing educational organizations in India — the University offers Graduate, Post Graduate & Research Programs across Engineering, Management, Pharmacy, Education, Hotel Management, Agriculture, Computer Applications, Law, Physiotherapy and more.
Situated on Sikar Road, Ajmer, our 112-acre green campus provides a challenging, open, and conducive environment for studies. We are among the top 5 universities across 90 colleges in Rajasthan, and our alumni are well-placed and growing globally.
— Dr. Anil Singh (Visionary chairman), Bhagwant university, Ajmer
Recognized State University
“EDUCATION has no boundaries as it is not limited to the CLASSROOMS”
Bhagwant Group of Institutions, a renowned name in the realm of education has taken giant strides in its progress. Bhagwant University, Ajmer, India has been established with an object of imparting academic excellence, upholding and maintaining ethical values. It will enrich knowledge, skills, attitude and belief so as to enable students to be successfully in their future endeavour. I welcome student fraternity to experience educational ambience at Bhagwant University, Ajmer.

Chairman, Bhagwant University
Bhagwant University Ajmer has been established with a pious objective of promoting and facilitating studies and research with focus on professional education. The University with its state of the art infrastructure and modern support facilities will impart high quality learning. We are committed to bring out the best in our students and help them not only to succeed in their studies but also to nurture the values that build strong confidence and character and produce market oriented, Industry driven and employable youths.
Vice Chairperson, Bhagwant University
EDUCATION is the passport to the FUTURE, For tomorrow belongs to those who prepare for it TODAY.

Recognizing the nature of our globalized environment BU sought to reap the benefits of the continuous technological advancements to offer our students a unique tech-savvy, scientific, and pedagogical experience that sets them apart from their colleagues and places them in the cusp of innovation and discovery. Our student-centred philosophy
Entailed the development of a modern system that fosters and develops the spirit of students, honing their skills and providing them with the tools needed to adapt to an ever-changing workplace environment. At BU, we believe in a growth mindset that capitalizes on the abilities of the individual, empowering them to shape their destiny throughout their years of study. Our students thrive in ana environment that develops their critical thinking and implement identity that is embedded in encouragement and social awareness.
As we push the boundaries of modernisation and collaboration with the academic and business world around us, we are in a constant race to meet the milestones that reflect the ambitions of our first-class faculty members, our talented students, and dedicated administration. We welcome you to join thousands of successful graduates who have learned under the guidance of caring, dedicated, and knowledgeable faculty. Our vision and dedication to our mission is as clear as ever. The new era at BU will follow the same trajectory of success and accomplishment, repositioning us among the leading institutions in the region. We invite you to make an investment in your future by studying at BHAGWANT UNIVERSITY.
Vice Chancellor, Bhagwant University
We envision a future where university-driven innovation plays a central role in shaping industries, solving global challenges, and defining the next generation of entrepreneurial success. Our mission is to bridge the gap between academic excellence and real-world application—empowering research, talent, and innovation to evolve into scalable, sustainable ventures.

Bhagwant University actively to identify high-potential ideas emerging from research labs, student initiatives, and faculty-led projects. Our approach is rooted in long-term planning to accelerate growth, and unlock opportunities.

Universities are not only centres of knowledge but also powerful engines of entrepreneurship. Through structured programs, innovation challenges, and incubation support, we aim to cultivate a culture where creativity meets execution. We are particularly focused on fostering interdisciplinary innovation—where technology, science, and business converge to address real-world challenges. 

Bhagwant University strives to build a pipeline of future-ready startups that drive economic growth, create employment, and deliver meaningful societal impact.

Pro Vice Chancellor, Bhagwant University
Dear Students, Faculty, and Staff warm greetings from the desk of the Registrar. Bhagwant University, Ajmer(Rajasthan) is a place where dreams are shaped into reality. Every step we take is guided by a vision of excellence, innovation and lifelong growth. We want you to grow every day in your knowledge, skills, and confidence. Every effort, every step brings you closer to the inspiration to set ambitious goals and reach them. Our mission is not only to provide high-quality education but also to shape individuals who will contribute positively to society.
Bhagwant University is a place where diversity is celebrated, innovation is encouraged, and lifelong learning is prioritized. I invite all students, faculty, and stakeholders to engage fully with the opportunities presented by the university and to contribute actively to our shared journey of growth and success. We are committed to continual improvement and to creating an inclusive and supportive atmosphere. I look forward to working closely with all members of the university to uphold the values and goals that define our university.
Stay motivated, stay informed and let’s achieve success together
Registrar, Bhagwant University
A World Class Teaching and Research Oriented University of Scholarly Excellence.
To import high quality technical, scientific, and professional university-level education.
Intelligent can mean academic results, Great test scores. Top marks on an essay. That’s one way to think. But at BHAGWANT UNIVERSITY, it’s not the only way, because we offer a personalized experience that develops every part of you. We teach you the technical skills to land your dream job, tin courses co-designed with industry. We offer work integrated employers value most: passion, resilience, empathy and curiosity. Our partnerships with international institutions and industries promote a truly global education for our students. That means a winning edge in today’s competitive job market. All of India witnesses a powerhouse environment at one of the world’s best institutions. Don’t just be Intelligent. Be all kinds of Intelligent.
Bhagwant University
Bhagwant University, Ajmer is a State Private University established under Rajasthan Act No. 18 of 2008 and recognized by the University Grants Commission (UGC) under Section 2(f) of the UGC Act, 1956. The University offers a wide range of undergraduate, postgraduate, diploma and doctoral programmes across various disciplines, with approvals and recognitions from relevant statutory and professional bodies for applicable programmes.
Bhagwant University, Ajmer offers a diverse range of Undergraduate, Postgraduate, Diploma, Certificate and Ph.D. programmes across disciplines including Engineering & Technology, Agriculture, Pharmacy, Management & Commerce, Computer Applications & IT, Law, Education, Physiotherapy, Hotel Management & Hospitality, Humanities & Applied Sciences, Yoga, Fire Safety & Disaster Management and other professional fields, with a focus on quality education, practical learning, research and career development.
Bhagwant University, Ajmer provides a modern and student-focused academic environment with well-equipped classrooms, laboratories, libraries, computer facilities, workshops, seminar halls, sports facilities and other essential campus amenities. The University is supported by qualified and experienced faculty members who focus on quality teaching, practical learning, research, innovation and the overall academic and professional development of students.

Bhagwant University is located on Sikar Road, Ajmer, Rajasthan. The University is approximately 10 km from the Ajmer Bus Station and 12 km from Ajmer Railway Station, with convenient connectivity through local bus services and road and rail transport to major nearby cities. item.command: /bin/bash -lc "sqlite3 -readonly -header -column assets/data/career_path.db \"WITH RECURSIVE tree(id,slug,name,parent_id,breadcrumb) AS (SELECT id,slug,name,parent_id,name FROM career_nodes WHERE parent_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT c.id,c.slug,c.name,c.parent_id,tree.breadcrumb || ' > ' || c.name FROM career_nodes c JOIN tree ON c.parent_id=tree.id) SELECT id AS career_node_id, slug AS career_node_slug, breadcrumb FROM tree WHERE lower(breadcrumb) GLOB '*engineering*' OR lower(breadcrumb) GLOB '*computer*' OR lower(breadcrumb) GLOB '*education*' OR lower(breadcrumb) GLOB '*agriculture*' OR lower(breadcrumb) GLOB '*management*' OR lower(breadcrumb) GLOB '*commerce*' OR lower(breadcrumb) GLOB '*library*' OR lower(breadcrumb) GLOB '*hotel*' OR lower(breadcrumb) GLOB '*yoga*' OR lower(breadcrumb) GLOB '*fire*' OR lower(breadcrumb) GLOB '*physio*' OR lower(breadcrumb) GLOB '*pharmacy*' OR lower(breadcrumb) GLOB '*law*' OR lower(breadcrumb) GLOB '*science*' OR lower(breadcrumb) GLOB '*language*' OR lower(breadcrumb) GLOB '*social*' OR lower(breadcrumb) GLOB '*agriculture*' OR lower(breadcrumb) GLOB '*mba*' OR lower(breadcrumb) GLOB '*bca*' OR lower(breadcrumb) GLOB '*mca*' OR lower(breadcrumb) GLOB '*bpt*' OR lower(breadcrumb) GLOB '*hotel*' ORDER BY id;\""
